name: Black Star Media — Open-Source GitHub Toolkit
source: Ez Peter Short, '9 GitHub repos that replace paid tools' (screen recording 26 Nov 2026)

tools.name: Open Generative AI
tools.what: AI image and cinematic video generation studio (desktop app or Docker).
tools.install: DMG from GitHub releases (Apple Silicon build)
tools.costs: Cloud models need a paid MuAPI key; local engines (Wan2GP) need a CUDA/ROCm GPU, so on an M1 Mac expect to use the paid key.
tools.watch_out: App is not notarised: right-click → Open on first launch.

tools.name: VoiceStudio
tools.what: Local voice studio: text-to-speech, voice cloning, voice design, dubbing and transcription on your own machine.
tools.install: brew tap debpalash/tap && brew install --cask debpalash/tap/voicestudio
tools.watch_out: The default OmniVoice model weights are CC-BY-NC (non-commercial). For monetised channels, pick a commercially licensed engine in the Model Manager. First generation downloads ~2.3 GB.

tools.name: OpenSEO
tools.what: Keyword research, rank tracking, backlinks, competitor insights and site audits.
tools.workflow_stage: 05 Distribution — SEO for blackstarmedia.com.au and video topics
tools.install: Docker Compose (deploy/standalone) or hosted at openseo.so
tools.costs: Pay-as-you-go DataForSEO API key (or treg token). Hosted plan is $10/month plus data.
tools.watch_out: Create the admin account immediately after first start; registration closes after that.

tools.name: AppFlowy
tools.what: Notes, docs, databases and kanban boards with local AI model support.
tools.workflow_stage: 01 Ideation — idea banks, scripts, content calendar
tools.install: brew install --cask appflowy (or DMG from releases); iPhone app on the App Store

tools.name: OpenWhispr
tools.what: Hotkey voice dictation into any app, online or offline, plus meeting and file transcription.
tools.workflow_stage: 01 Ideation / 02 Prompt — dictate ideas, hooks and prompts
tools.costs: Local transcription free; free cloud tier is 2,000 words/week.
tools.watch_out: Needs macOS microphone and accessibility permissions for auto-paste.

tools.name: OpenProject
tools.what: Tasks, projects, kanban boards, Gantt charts and time tracking.
tools.workflow_stage: All stages — production board per video
tools.watch_out: Heavy (~4 GB RAM). Default login admin / admin; you'll be asked to change it.

tools.name: Cal.diy
tools.what: Booking pages that sync with Google and Outlook calendars (Cal.com community edition).
tools.workflow_stage: Business — sponsor calls, collabs, AIM workshop bookings
tools.watch_out: The project says personal, non-production use only. For client-facing bookings, use hosted Cal.com.

tools.name: Chatwoot
tools.what: One inbox for website chat, email, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and more.
tools.workflow_stage: 05 Distribution — leads, sponsors and community DMs
tools.costs: Free self-hosted; Captain AI and some features are paid.
tools.watch_out: Website chat for real visitors needs a public server (VPS), not your laptop.

tools.name: Cap
tools.what: Screen + camera recorder with editor, captions, AI titles/chapters and share links.
tools.costs: Desktop app free for local recording; Cap Cloud features paid.
